text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through a somewhat 
urban town with Nice Nature...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's Nature-san over there! No way! 
What an aura. I'm actually a pretty big 
fan.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Really? I watched the race broadcast too! 
She was super fast, seriously strong. 
Girls who run in GⅠ races really are on 
another level~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ummm... Were you just talking about 
me...?
choice_data_list: They were totally gushing about us...!

They were totally gushing about us, 
huh...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, exactly! Was the public reaction 
always like this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature has built up quite the track 
record, too. It seems more and more people 
have become fans after seeing what she can 
do!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... 'Looking up to Nature-san inspired 
me to take the exam for Tracen Academy.' 
Whoa... for real?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The number of fan letters has noticeably 
increased! Filled with pride, we read them 
together. However...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I was torn between taking a job transfer 
overseas or staying in Japan, but I want 
to see your races to the end, so I decided 
to stay"... it says.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious...? Making such a huge 
decision just because of me...
choice_data_list:
That's just how important it is to that 
person.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, this is your life we're 
talking about...? It's a major turning 
point, right? And you're just...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are you... really sure...? I'm not... 
really anyone special...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no way! Of course I'm happy! 
Naturally! Is our Nature finally getting 
that big-shot aura going~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...! Maybe I'll go buy myself some 
reward sweets...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, with her awkward steps, I was 
able to catch up right away... Sure 
enough, she was heading in the exact 
opposite direction of the school store.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-What...?
choice_data_list: Tell me, don't leave anything out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... N-No, I mean... I'm saying I'm 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Why do you always see right through me, 
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I didn't expect it to be this 
heavy."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to be... that sparkling 
girl who gets cheered on by so many 
people, yet...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Won't this end up letting them down 
someday? Like, "I knew she just didn't 
have what it takes to win in the end~"...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……! Aaaaaaah……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She finally opened up her true feelings. I 
crouched down right beside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for conflicting feelings 
to arise. I wanted to listen more 
carefully. And I wanted to accept them—her 
true, honest feelings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Wait, ramen *again*...?
choice_data_list:
I figured you'd be getting hungry about 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrr gurgle rumble rumble)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah. Even when you're exhausted, 
you still get hungry...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the grub... *huff*... 
*slurp*... Ahh, so good... 
..................*sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, the steam, the steam! I'm fine, 
so please don't look over here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I should be the one apologizing. 
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, you see... Will you listen to the rest 
of what I was saying earlier...?
choice_data_list: Of course, as much as you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She opened up in brief, halting words. Her 
tangled emotions spilling out in 
disorganized thoughts. Slowly, while 
slurping her ramen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, thanks for the meal. That was 
delicious...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, slowly but surely, I guess? I 
mean, it's not like I'm gonna "bounce back 
instantly!" or anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's strange... Having someone to eat with 
like this makes me feel like everything 
might just be okay...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure it'll be fine.
Yeah, everything will be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah, yeah... Even if it's just 
little by little, I have to keep looking 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Today I'll go home early and 
sleep early. Time to switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-san. Everything will work 
out, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Fufu...! Thanks. I'll give it my all!
